name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.8 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 46 hours starting 2025-11-03, at wavelengths from 0.83 to 4.55 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
